name: performance-health
description: performance-health CLI surface. Single source of truth for the scenario's command shape: schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against the proto descriptors at test time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest. Each group mirrors one API domain; the shared ScenarioValidationService procedures are intentionally omitted (they are the test-genie delegation surface, not a developer CLI verb).

groups.name: audit
groups.description: Orchestrate a profile-mode perf capture of a scenario (cleanly skips when capture is impossible)

commands.name: run
commands.description: Restart a scenario in profile build mode, drive a BAS perf capture (optionally a specific interaction), and restore the default build. Returns a trace artifact; hand it to `analysis analyze --trace <key>` to read the ⚛ component/web-vitals signals. Outcome 'unavailable' (no browser/BAS) is loud and distinct from 'skipped' (no UI).

flags.name: workflow
flags.description: Perf-flow slug to drive a SPECIFIC interaction inside the trace window — resolves to <scenario>/bas/flows/<slug>.json (an assertion-free flow marked intent:performance; use literal [data-testid=...] selectors). Empty = default navigate+mount-settle. Example: --workflow scroll-dashboard. See the `performance` skill and bas/README.md for the authoring loop.
